rca_of_issue: Prior iteration_10 issue: on react-native-web the outer tab bar uses border-box sizing, so tabBarStyle.height INCLUDED paddingTop+paddingBottom, squeezing the inner content and clipping labels to 3px. Current fix (line 50): height = contentHeight(60) + paddingTop(8) + bottomInset (min 10 iOS / 12 Android). This adds padding ON TOP of content area, giving labels the ~15px they need at fontSize:12 (12*1.2 line-height). Verified — all labels visible, tab-item touch target 55px >= 44pt.
